name: Okta MCP
description: Custom local Okta MCP server built on FastMCP 2.0. Full Okta management API surface: users, groups, apps, membership, security audit log, and session management.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List/search Okta users

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get user profile (accepts first.last shortname)

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Create a new Okta user

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Update user profile fields

tools.name: deactivate_user
tools.description: Deactivate an Okta user account

tools.name: activate_user
tools.description: Activate a staged or deprovisioned user

tools.name: suspend_user
tools.description: Suspend an active user (blocks sign-in)

tools.name: unsuspend_user
tools.description: Restore a suspended user to active

tools.name: unlock_user
tools.description: Unlock a locked-out user

tools.name: expire_password
tools.description: Force password reset on next sign-in

tools.name: reset_password
tools.description: Send password reset email or return reset token

tools.name: get_user_groups
tools.description: List all groups a user belongs to

tools.name: get_user_apps
tools.description: List all app assignments for a user

tools.name: get_user_factors
tools.description: List enrolled MFA factors for a user

tools.name: list_user_sessions
tools.description: List active sessions for a user

tools.name: clear_user_sessions
tools.description: Revoke all active sessions for a user

tools.name: add_user_to_group
tools.description: Add a user to an Okta group

tools.name: remove_user_from_group
tools.description: Remove a user from an Okta group

tools.name: assign_app_to_user
tools.description: Directly assign an app to a user

tools.name: remove_app_from_user
tools.description: Remove a direct app assignment from a user

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List/search Okta groups

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Get group details (accepts name or short name)

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a new Okta group

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Update a group's name or description

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete an Okta group

tools.name: list_group_members
tools.description: List all users in a group

tools.name: list_group_apps
tools.description: List apps assigned to a group

tools.name: assign_app_to_group
tools.description: Assign an app to a group

tools.name: remove_app_from_group
tools.description: Remove an app assignment from a group

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List/search Okta applications

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get application details (accepts name or partial name)

tools.name: list_app_users
tools.description: List users directly assigned to an app

tools.name: list_app_groups
tools.description: List groups assigned to an app

tools.name: get_security_events
tools.description: Query Okta System Log for security events

tools.name: get_login_history
tools.description: Get recent sign-in events for a user

tools.name: get_failed_logins
tools.description: Get failed authentication events

envVars.name: OKTA_ORG_DOMAIN
envVars.description: Email domain for first.last shortname resolution, e.g. acme.com

changelog.notes: Full tool surface: 36 tools covering users, groups, apps, membership, audit log, and sessions. Interactive setup with Keeper integration. Shortname resolution for users (first.last) and fuzzy name matching for groups/apps.
Added login risk assessment and concurrent session limits.
Migrated to FastMCP 2.0 with Streamable HTTP support.
Initial Okta MCP server with core IAM tools.
